Digilent rgb2dvi source snapshot
================================

Source: https://github.com/Digilent/vivado-library/tree/master/ip/rgb2dvi

Files under `src/` were downloaded from Digilent `vivado-library` `master`
for the 06S2 PYNQ-Z2 HDMI demo variant. The source headers state BSD 3-clause
license terms and Digilent copyright. The original files are kept unmodified.

This phase uses the RTL source directly rather than packaging a Vivado IP
catalog component, so the LED-only 06S2 demo can remain independent of the HDMI
experiment.
